execution_assumptions.entry: At signal-bar close; stop checks begin on the next bar.
execution_assumptions.initial_stop: Entry plus/minus the configured multiple of EWMA M5 range.
execution_assumptions.trailing_stop: Activates after the configured favorable move and follows the best observed price by the configured range multiple. Stop updates become active from the following candle.
execution_assumptions.intrabar_ambiguity: Existing stop is checked before updating the trail from the current candle's high/low; this avoids assuming a favorable intrabar order when OHLC does not reveal the path.
execution_assumptions.position_management: One position per setup strategy; later signals are ignored until exit. Maximum hold is 144 M5 bars, then exit at close.
execution_assumptions.costs: HistData is bid-only; spread, commission, and slippage are excluded.

warning: Stop parameters are a research grid, not optimized live settings. Validation and test results are exploratory; test period was previously inspected. Gross R is not net profitability.
